# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations, just add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

- The trajectory JSON structure for some benchmarks (e.g. SpreadsheetBench) uses a `rollout.trace` list of role/content pairs rather than explicit `tool` and `output` fields in every entry. The `diagnose` skill and standard scripts should be more robust to this variation to simplify manual analysis.
